description: This file defines models, enums, constants, and utility functions for digital gauge widget configurations in a dashboard application, including gauge types, layout mappings, color settings, and compatibility functions.

methods.name: backwardCompatibilityFixedLevelColors
methods.description: Converts fixed level colors to advanced color range format for compatibility.

methods.name: backwardCompatibilityTicks
methods.description: Converts tick value sources to a consistent format for compatibility.

methods.name: convertLevelColorsSettingsToColorProcessor
methods.description: Processes and applies color settings to the digital gauge configuration.
